reuse.why: Computes the field with the existing exported getScheduledAmount, the same helper the client's schedule views use for missing, numeric and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; the API model just calls the shared helper.

placement.why: The derived field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API shape of a schedule is produced.

scope.why: Only the API type, its mapping and the expectations in the existing API test change.

maintainability.why: Any change to how the expected amount is decided flows to the API automatically; the only nit is the import's placement among the type imports.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount rather than its own range handling.
